witness_protocol.bindings: by is exact observed producer identity; verified_at is exact observed parseable ISO8601 timestamp. No substitution of bytes or invented producer output.
witness_protocol.source_pins: Every source path (JSONL/META/name_fold/verified data file) must have its actual SHA256, and every span must resolve to the retained source bytes.
witness_protocol.result: VALIDATOR GREEN or native file validation only; provenance of witness and genuine writer RED/GREEN remains executor responsibility. Missing/bypassed/wrong witness is INCOMPLETE or failure.
